messages.毎ターン傲慢共鳴3でドッケビの腕を得て、クイック3以上を保ちながらドッケビの火を: A Blade Lineage Poise attacker that gains Dokkaebi Arms each turn through 3 Pride Resonance. Maintain at least 3 Haste while building 15 Dokkaebi Fire to repeatedly trigger Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame. Deliberately losing defense clashes to use To Claim Their Bones is another main pattern.
messages.バトルパッシブ「リンバス・カンパニー制作特殊義体試製品mk5-ドッケビの腕」(傲: **Combat passive — Limbus Company Specialized Custom Prosthetic Prototype mk5 - Dokkaebi Arms (3 Pride Resonance; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: Gains Dokkaebi Arms at Combat Start (−15% damage taken; 1 Haste next turn on skill use). At the end of a skill, gains Dokkaebi Fire per 3 Poise Potency, up to 5, twice per turn. Her main source of Dokkaebi Fire.
messages.ドッケビの火(正式名「ムク工房 - イェ[鋭]二式抜刀 / 推力:ドッケビの火」: **Dokkaebi Fire** (official name: Mook Workshop - Ye [銳] Type II Bladedraw / Thrust Force: Dokkaebi Fire): Maximum 20, up to 10 per turn. At 15 or more at the end of a basic attack skill, Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame triggers, and all of it is spent after the attack. At Turn End, 1 Haste next turn per 5, up to 3. −1 Clash Power for Defense skills per 2.
messages.クイック3・5: S1「勢法」・S2「刺法」はドッケビの腕を持ちクイック3以上な: **3 and 5 Haste**: S1 Rending Arts and S2 Acupuncture reuse a Coin while she has Dokkaebi Arms and 3 or more Haste. Even the Balance - Lucent Rippling Flame reuses Coin Ⅳ on Critical Hit at 5 or more Haste. S3 Lucent Rippling Flame and the Defense skill I'll Light the Path Forward grant 2 Haste next turn.
messages.「骨断」: 守備スキルのマッチに負けたとき、クイックが3以上なら、守備スキル終了: **To Claim Their Bones**: When her Defense skill loses a Clash, if she has 3 or more Haste, she does not stagger until the Defense skill ends, and the follow-up To Claim Their Bones triggers (twice per turn). It inflicts 1 Slash Fragility. Her Defense skill also grants Assist Defense, and if she has Haste at the end of the skill, she gains 2 Dokkaebi Fire.
messages.剣契との連携: パッシブ「帰るべき場所」により、ステージ初登場時に、戦場にいる剣: **Coordination with Blade Lineage**: Through the passive To Where I Must Return, on first appearing in a stage, she gains 1 Bearing of a Salsu (+1 Offense Level, up to 3) per Blade Lineage ally on the field. Meursault's Blade Lineage Mentor's passive Swordplay of the Homeland (3 Pride Resonance) grants her Swordplay of the Homeland, making him a near-essential partner.
messages.傲慢のスキルをそろえて毎ターン傲慢共鳴3を起こすのが大前提。序盤は呼吸と精神力を: Triggering 3 Pride Resonance every turn by lining up Pride skills is the core premise. Early on, build Poise and SP. Even the Balance spends all Fire after the attack, so every use means building up again. From the midgame on, once Poise has built up, she can aim for a two-turn cycle: bring Fire to 10 or more with her Defense skill or S3 while securing Haste for the next turn, then fire Even the Balance at 5 Haste the next turn. However, the Fire from a single S3 may fall short of 10 depending on Poise Potency and Critical Hits. Using skills multiple times per turn through Assist Defense or To Claim Their Bones, triggering the passive's Fire gain (twice per turn) both times, makes it easier to reach. If you can afford it, place her Defense skill instead of S1 and bring out To Claim Their Bones from Clash losses to earn Fire and extra actions. However, losing Clashes raises the enemy's SP, so do not overdo aiming for To Claim Their Bones.
